title: The Dance Card
subtitle: A reward gated on a scoreboard objective
description: The dance card pays on favour, and favour is a scoreboard
objective: `tasked_harvest_favour`, created by the bell's command
reward at the start of the week and scored however the village
scores it -- the prizes below go only to a card whose objective
A missing objective reads as zero, not as an error, which is the
score condition's one warning: the bell made the objective, and a
pack that skips the bell has a gate with no keyhole.
